title: Akiyama Mizuki — Profile Story

rows.Line: Mizuki's Room

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hmm... What should I say for my self-intro? You've made this a lot harder for me, Enanan...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Huh? You reap what you sow?
Haha. Yeah, I can't really argue with that.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Anyway, I'm just gonna say whatever comes to mind. So, here we go!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<I'm Mizuki Akiyama, AKA Amia!
I'm the video editor for Nightcord at 25:00.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Heh heh heh.
AKA... I've always wanted to say that.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oh, sorry. I didn't mean to get off topic.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Anyway, I explained how I became the video editor for N25 last time, so I think I'll talk about something else for this one...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Alright, for this self-intro, I'm gonna talk about times I feel really happy about being a part of N25.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Starting with...when we're all at the diner together!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <We didn't actually meet in person for a long time, but we finally did after one thing led to another... Now, we go out to celebrate every time we upload a new video.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <We get to talk about random stuff, I get to try some of that ramen K likes so much and really just relax. It's really nice.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Which is why I hope we get to keep doing that in the future♪>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Next is...when the others really get how I feel!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <How should I put it? Sometimes there are things that are tough for me to discuss, but I'm able to tell them things that I wouldn't to anyone else...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Like the way I think it's unfair when the cherry blossom petals fall off, instead of just finding it pretty... Just as an example!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <The others understand how I feel, which makes me really glad to be a part of N25.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<And...
When we're able to help each other out when we really need it...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Hehe.
There's so much I wanna talk about! But I'm gonna stop here since it'll take until morning for me to get to everything!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Huh? I should've thought this through more? I mean, I can't really do much about that...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Then, lemme end with...
I really love N25 and hope you'll keep giving us your support♪>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <How's that?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Cool!
K seems okay with it!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <So, everyone, make sure to stay tuned!>
